WorkspaceDocument.title: WorkspaceDocument
WorkspaceDocument.description: Authenticated dentist user's complete DUS 2027 strategic workspace state stored as native Firestore maps.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the synchronized DUS 2027 state.

studyDate.description: Active study date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

streakDays.description: Active consecutive study streak in days.

stateMap.description: Native Firestore map containing topicsById, recordsById, studyPlansById, questionLogsById, mockExamsById, topicTaxonomyById, semanticErrorsById, and ankiStats.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the workspace document was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest synchronization write.

/workspaces/{userId}.description: Single-document cloud synchronization workspace scoped strictly to the authenticated user's UID.
